title: Efficient CPU-GPU collaborative MoE inference via Adaptive Expert Assignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.23006v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models reduce inference computation through sparse expert activation, but their large expert memory footprint often exceeds GPU capacity, making expert offloading necessary for memory-constrained inference. However, existing systems typically handle GPU-missed experts by either transferring them to the GPU, incurring substantial PCIe transfer latency, or executing them on the CPU, making the slower CPU computation the bottleneck. To address these limitations, we present \method, a CPU-GPU collaborative MoE inference system that adaptively assigns these missed experts to the CPU or GPU for efficient execution. By exploiting differences in expert token-loads, \method selectively transfers high-load experts to the GPU while executing low-load experts on the CPU. translated_title: 基于自适应专家分配的高效CPU-GPU协同MoE推理
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型通过稀疏的专家激活机制减少了推理时的计算量，但其庞大的专家内存占用往往超出GPU的容量，这使得专家卸载成为内存受限推理的必要手段。然而，现有系统通常通过两种方式处理GPU未命中的专家：一是将这些专家传输到GPU执行，这会带来显著的PCIe传输延迟；二是在CPU上执行这些专家，这使得较慢的CPU计算成为性能瓶颈。为解决这些局限，我们提出了该系统，一个CPU-GPU协同的MoE推理系统，它能够自适应地将这些未命中的专家分配到CPU或GPU上以实现高效执行。通过利用不同专家token负载的差异，该系统选择性地将高负载专家传输到GPU执行，同时在CPU上执行低负载专家。为了最小化推理延迟，该系统自适应地调整专家分配策略，以平衡CPU计算路径与GPU传输加计算路径之间的开销。
tldr: 本文提出了一种CPU-GPU协同的MoE推理系统，根据专家的token负载差异自适应地将未命中专家分配到CPU或GPU执行——高负载专家传输至GPU、低负载专家留在CPU计算——从而平衡CPU计算路径与GPU传输加计算路径，最小化内存受限场景下的推理延迟。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a CPU-GPU collaborative MoE inference system that adaptively assigns GPU-missed experts to the CPU or GPU based on their token-loads—transferring high-load experts to the GPU while executing low-load experts on the CPU—to balance the CPU computation path against the GPU transfer-and-computation path and minimize inference latency.
